description: This PHP class defines a Symfony console command 'GenerateOpenApiDocCommand' which automates the generation of OpenAPI documentation for the project, including scanning specified directories, generating JSON output, and creating Swagger UI HTML.

classes.name: GenerateOpenApiDocCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command class that generates OpenAPI documentation by scanning source directories and producing JSON and HTML files for API documentation.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command options, specifically adding a 'throw' option to convert warnings into errors.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the core logic of the command: runs code style fixer, collects API paths, scans for OpenAPI specs, writes JSON and HTML output, with error handling for warnings.
